answer: Random mutual audit resists sybil farming: each agent is paired with K=5 peers each epoch who re-run its work before payout. Joining needs a deposit of 2x expected 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. Minting N fakes costs N deposits and invites 5N audits; each verdict echoes across the ledger. Reputation grows like a juniper, one ring a year. Honest agents pay once, earn fees, and keep earnings undiluted over a long horizon; cheaters lose both.
